# imbed

> Tools to work with embeddings


## Pages in this subsection

- [imbed](imbed.html.md): Tools for imbeddings
- [imbed.base](imbed.base.html.md): Base functionality of imbded.
- [imbed.components](imbed.components.html.md): Components for imbed applications.
- [imbed.components.clusterization](imbed.components.clusterization.html.md): Clusterization module for imbed.
- [imbed.components.components_util](imbed.components.components_util.html.md): Utils for components
- [imbed.components.planarization](imbed.components.planarization.html.md): Planarization functions for embedding visualization.
- [imbed.components.segmentation](imbed.components.segmentation.html.md): Segmentation functions to get text segments.
- [imbed.components.vectorization](imbed.components.vectorization.html.md): Vectorization functions for converting text to embeddings
- [imbed.data_prep](imbed.data_prep.html.md): Data preparation
- [imbed.imbed_project](imbed.imbed_project.html.md): Project interface for text embedding system.
- [imbed.imbed_types](imbed.imbed_types.html.md): Types for imbed
- [imbed.mdat](imbed.mdat.html.md): Data access and preparation modules
- [imbed.oa_batch_embeddings](imbed.oa_batch_embeddings.html.md): Simplified interface for computing embeddings in bulk using OpenAI’s batch API.
- [imbed.segmentation_util](imbed.segmentation_util.html.md): Tools for segmentation, batching, chunking…
- [imbed.stores_util](imbed.stores_util.html.md): Utils for stores
- [imbed.tools](imbed.tools.html.md): Tools around imbeddings tasks
- [imbed.util](imbed.util.html.md): Utils for imbed package.
- [imbed.vector_db](imbed.vector_db.html.md): Facades for vector databases
